A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HCV‐related HCC with high AFP levels is more closely related to the severity of liver disease than is HCC with high PIVKA‐II levels.
PIVKA‐II‐predominant cases had a higher risk of HCC than did AFP‐predominant ones, and that the former had more advanced HCV infection and a greater risk of developing HCC.
HCCs with a high PIVKA‐II level have a high incidence of cirrhosis and a high viral load.
